verdict.rationale: Metorial is an integration and MCP-hosting platform, so a built-in assistant is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows it connecting external AI agents and MCP clients (Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude) to tools. Magic Skills are workflows packaged for those external agents, and the sample bots are applications developers build themselves, so neither is an in-product assistant users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
